purpose: Phase 5 — Remaining Majors (FR8). Enumerates the post-W5 concrete target version for every W5-remaining family and the manifest-owner set. The w5 Red-phase TDD suite asserts (a) this fixture exists, (b) it carries every W5-remaining family from the matrix (Tailwind CSS, KaTeX, Lucide React, jsdom), (c) every listed target satisfies the spec target_after_all_waves major floor, and (d) the installed lockfile version equals the target. Green behavior: a w5 Green commit refreshes the lockfile to these versions and re-runs the audit contract.
compatibility_requirement: Every target must satisfy the post-W5 declared manifest range for every owner workspace. Tailwind 4.x (config + PostCSS pipeline break — test-strategy.md §3), KaTeX 0.17.x (0.16→0.17 breaking, may affect packages/lesson-renderer and packages/activity-components consumers), Lucide React 1.x (0.x→1.x breaking, may affect packages/lesson-renderer suite), jsdom 29.x (test-environment compatibility changes likely — verify per-app vitest suite).

targets.notes: T1 isolated upgrade. Breaking config + PostCSS pipeline — test-strategy.md §3. Requires per-app build verification, not just unit tests. Postcss v4 (the new engine) requires @tailwindcss/postcss as a separate package. The five apps' tailwind.config.ts files use TypeScript Config imports; v4 prefers CSS-first config (theme tokens, no JS config).

T2 isolated upgrade. 0.16→0.17 breaking per KaTeX changelog. test-strategy.md §3 requires running packages/lesson-renderer and packages/activity-components suites first. May break shared component consumers (IM3 uses @matejmazur/react-katex which has a ^3.1.3 peer on katex — verify peer satisfaction).

T2 isolated upgrade. 0.x→1.x breaking — lucide-react v1.0 promotes a stable API, removes tree-shaking workaround imports, and re-exports the icon set as ESM. test-strategy.md §3 requires running packages/lesson-renderer suite first. P3 floor (^0.511.0) does NOT admit 1.x; W5 is the major migration.

T3 isolated upgrade. 26→29 carries test-environment compatibility changes (jsdom 27 added CSS.supports polyfill, 28 modernized URL/URLSearchParams, 29 dropped legacy Node <18 support). Verify per-app vitest suite; test-strategy.md §3 calls this out explicitly.
